name: io.github.Servosity/microsoft-graph-mcp
title: Microsoft Graph MCP
description: The maintained single-binary successor to the retiring mgc  -  every MSP-relevant Microsoft Graph

environmentVariables.name: MICROSOFT_GRAPH_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL for the Microsoft Graph API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

environmentVariables.name: MICROSOFT_GRAPH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Set the MICROSOFT_GRAPH_TOKEN credential for the Microsoft Graph MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: MICROSOFT_GRAPH_HOME_TENANT
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Your own Microsoft 365 tenant ID (Entra admin center > Overview > Tenant ID). The transcripts commands need it: they read meeting transcripts in this tenant only and refuse a token for any other tenant. Leave blank if you do not use transcripts.

environmentVariables.name: MICROSOFT_GRAPH_TRANSCRIPTS_APP_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to let the transcripts commands use an app-only token in your own tenant. Do this only after a Teams application access policy limits the app to named users (New-CsApplicationAccessPolicy, then Grant-CsApplicationAccessPolicy). Leave blank to accept a signed-in user's token only.

environmentVariables.name: MICROSOFT_GRAPH_MCP_NO_TRANSCRIPTS
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to hide the transcripts tools from the MCP server and refuse them. Leave blank to keep the read-only transcripts tools.

environmentVariables.name: MICROSOFT_GRAPH_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing execute call. Leave blank to keep every tool available.

environmentVariables.name: MICROSOFT_GRAPH_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: nothing new is written to the local store. Leave blank to keep the local store.

environmentVariables.name: MICROSOFT_GRAPH_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Microsoft Graph requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Only for tenant-gated multi-client deployments: binds the MCP server to an existing Printing Press client profile. Leave blank for a single-tenant install.

environmentVariables.name: MICROSOFT_GRAPH_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.
